The '''Ringo Vinda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a [[Ringo Vinda space station/Legends|space station]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="The Unknown" /> the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]]<ref name="FF-2014 52: Ringo Vinda">{{FactFile2014|52|20 BBY 55-60|Clone conspiracy}}</ref> was fought in the system between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="The Unknown" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="FF-2014 52: Ringo Vinda" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ringo Vinda system first appeared in "[[The Unknown]],"<ref name="The Unknown" /> the first episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]],<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-episode-guide|text="The Unknown" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> which originally aired in [[Wikipedia:Germany|Germany]] on [[February 15]], [[2014]].<ref name="Jedi News">{{WebCite|url=http://www.jedinews.co.uk/misc/articles/star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-six-launching-15th-february-in-germany|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Season Six Launching 15th February In Germany|author=Mark Newbold|date=2014-01-16, 11:31 AM, BST|work=[http://www.jedinews.co.uk Jedi News]|archivedate=20170425214828}}</ref> It was first identified in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square R-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
